title: Emergency conference at Camp Hood on nuclear-site UFOs
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Emergency conference at Camp Hood on nuclear-site UFOs, about Cold War at Texas (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: an emergency conference was held at Camp Hood, Texas, which included the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, the Army Counter Intelligence Command, and the FBI.

plain: Because of UFO sightings near nuclear sites, an emergency meeting is said to have been held at Camp Hood, an Army base in Texas, bringing together the Air Force's own detective branch, the Army's counter-spy branch, and the FBI, the US federal police. Jesse Michels tells this himself during the Cold War part of his story, without naming a source. If true, it would mean several security agencies treated the sightings as a real threat.
